headline: Sensex gains 400 points and Nifty climbs above 22,700 as crude oil prices moderate and IT leads

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices dropped, easing pressure on domestic equities.
IT sector led gains, driving recovery in Indian shares after recent declines.
Analysts noted fears of rate hikes triggering a prolonged bank stock selloff may be overdone.
Centre notified tighter CAFE fuel-efficiency targets for passenger vehicles.
whatHappening: Sensex recovered around 400 points while Nifty traded near 22,750.
Nifty Healthcare index fell 2% despite the broader market rebound.
Axiscades Technologies surged 5% after Abakkus acquired a 3.03% stake.
Sun TV share price continued its rally, rising over 30% in September.
summary: Indian stock markets rebounded on September 30 as Sensex gained up to 400 points and Nifty traded above 22,700. Declining crude oil prices and gains in IT stocks propelled the recovery, while Healthcare lagged. Individual stocks like Axiscades Technologies and Sun TV saw sharp gains following positive news triggers.
